name: PUDU D9
summary: The bipedal humanoid from Pudu Robotics, a Shenzhen company that has shipped tens of thousands of wheeled hospitality and delivery robots. D9 extends that commercial base into a legged form for material transport and service tasks; the smaller D7 targets lighter duties.
notable: Backed by a large installed base of commercial service robots
Aimed at hospitality, delivery and light logistics
